newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH LEZAJSK BREWER SELL-OFF SEEN BY EARLY DEC.
newsitem.headline: POLISH LEZAJSK BREWER SELL-OFF SEEN BY EARLY DEC.

text.p: The Polish Treasury Ministry expects to sell the Zaklady Piwowarskie w Lezajsku SA (Lezajsk) brewery late this month or early in December, deputy minister Wieslaw Kaczmarek said on Tuesday.
Kaczmarek told a news briefing the ministry was still in talks with two domestic investors but was keen to seal the deal quickly to start the brewer's necessary restructuring.

"I think that, having two investors (bidding for Lezajsk) to choose from, we will conclude this project...and this should happen this month or early in December because this company really needs an investor to help it recover its position," Kaczmarek said.
He did not identify the two potential investors.
The treasury is offering up to 75 percent of Lezajsk, based in southeastern Poland.
According to 1994 data, the most recent figures available, the brewer netted 90,000 zlotys on sales of 71.7 million. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
